I almost didn't write this one down. It started as a note to myself after a rough Tuesday, and honestly it's still a little rough around the edges.

We shipped the release late. Not because the code was bad, but because nobody wanted to be the one who said "not yet" out loud. I said it eventually. Felt awkward. Worth it though.

Here's what actually helped: a fifteen minute check-in, twice a week, where the only rule was you had to say one thing that was going badly. Not polished status updates. Just the messy stuff.

Would I do it again? Probably. Would I do it exactly the same way? No idea yet.
